title: NMAX 155 Connected (Classic Heritage)
description: The Yamaha NMAX 155 Connected (Classic Heritage) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 155cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
